calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Grail buy-and-hold high-risk play: Galleri blood test screens for 50+ cancers from stage zero; FDA committee was positive 26 Sep, approval expected early 2027. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Approval in Q1 2027 is likely in his view; a ~$5bn company could reach ~$20bn (4x) if the test becomes routine for over-50s.
calls.bull_case: Medicare coverage would open floodgates; he calls it a potential 10-bagger in a few years and a likely takeover target (e.g. J&J).
calls.bear_case: Expect major volatility — it lost ~50% in a week in the last year before rising ~4x from the bottom; approval/Medicare are not certain.
